labels: Target/control roles identify desired structural preference. Newly proposed peptides have unknown measured binding.
site_selection: Joint exposed-surface and shape comparison using all three targets and both controls; sites are structural hypotheses.

experimental_references.observation: A designed peptide showed conformer-specific binding against other alpha-synuclein amyloids, tau and A-beta40 in the published study.
experimental_references.scope: Supports the feasibility of conformer recognition. Its experimental labels remain specific to the published peptides and tested fibrils; new MSA sequences have unknown measured binding.

unavailable_evidence: Systematic mapped antibody epitopes and competition or mutagenesis measurements for the current four surfaces.
